content: In a footnote Melvin-Koushki gives examples of ambiguity at court: Shāhrukh's wife Gawharshād, though a dedicated Sunni, endowed a mosque complex at the shrine of Imam ʿAlī al-Riḍā in Mashhad; Sulṭān-Ḥusayn Bāyqarā tried on accession to have the khuṭba given in the name of the twelve Imams and was stopped by ʿAlī Shīr Navāʾī.
refers_to_primary: Gawharshād; Sulṭān-Ḥusayn Bāyqarā; coinage (per MK fn.129)
